profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker PONY, with its headquarters listed as Guangzhou. It describes itself as a global autonomous driving technology company pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility, aiming to bring what it calls safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility worldwide. The company says it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and now operates at an expanding footprint of sites around the world.

Per its own site, Pony.ai organizes its work around three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). Its core technology is a system it calls the "virtual driver." The company states that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations. It describes its testing as covering complex weather and road conditions, which it presents as groundwork for scalable autonomous driving products and services.

The company's SEC filings identify it by CIK 0001969302. No litigation, tracked products, or MCP servers appear in the record for Pony AI Inc.
